verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an instant, no-auth domain availability/pricing check across hundreds of TLDs (porkbun-docs-35), and community feedback notes the UI 'loads fast' (porkbun-comm-2), supporting the 'fast' part of the story. However there is no evidence of alternate-TLD suggestion features in search results, and no documentation or independent confirmation addressing anti-squatting/front-running practices on searched names. Missing for 10: alternate-TLD suggestion evidence, explicit no-squatting/front-running policy or independent verification of it.
